name: Whispers and Wagers
source:
You're forced into a deadly game where secrets seduce and trust kills. To survive, you'll have to play dirty, love dangerously, and risk everything.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你被迫卷入一场致命游戏——在这里，秘密充满诱惑，信任却能招致杀身之祸。为了活下去，你必须不择手段、在危险边缘谈情说爱，并赌上自己的一切。

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]]
